corsica.sourceNote: EDF SEI Corse real-time generation by source (https://opendata-corse.edf.fr/datasets/production-delectricite-par-filiere-en-temps-reel), solar + wind + hydro summed. EDF marks these rows estimated (telemetry and estimates), not metered. Rolling window of 14.2 days, 1344 intervals; the 30-day total is this window's diurnal mean × 30 days (GWh: solar 14.5, wind 2.5, hydro 57.3). The feed has no curtailment column: waste unpublished, no rate applied. Missing ≠ zero. Not T1a.
